features: DIGITEK DAC 201 - 8K ULTRA HD WATERPROOF ACTION CAMERA: Capture your adventures in stunning 8K Ultra HD quality with the DIGITEK DAC 201, designed for action enthusiasts who demand the best in performance and durability

WATERPROOF DEPTH OF UP TO 30M: Dive into the depths with confidence! This action camera features a robust waterproof design, allowing it to be submerged up to 30 meters (98 feet), making it perfect for underwater photography and water sports.

BUILT-IN MICROPHONE WITH EXTERNAL MICROPHONE OPTION: Enjoy clear audio recording with the built-in microphone, and enhance your sound quality further by connecting an external microphone for more professional audio capture.

6 AXIS GYRO EIS STABILIZATION: Say goodbye to shaky footage! The 6-axis Gyro Electronic Image Stabilization (EIS) ensures smooth, steady videos even in the most challenging conditions, so you can focus on your action-packed moments.

DUAL SCREEN FOR USER-FRIENDLY OPERATION: Featuring a 2" IPS touchscreen on the front and a 1.3" screen on the back, the dual screens allow for easy navigation and framing of shots, making it simple to capture the perfect angle.
64MP INTERPOLATED IMAGE CAPTURE: Capture breathtaking images with a resolution of up to 64MP (interpolated), ensuring your photos are vibrant and detailed, ready for sharing or printing.

EXPANDABLE STORAGE UP TO 128GB: Capture more without worry! The DAC 201 supports TF cards of up to 128GB (UHS-III rating required for 4K video resolution), ensuring you have plenty of space for all your adventures.
iSMART DV2 WIFI APP FOR EASY SHARING: Seamlessly connect your DIGITEK DAC 201 to the iSmart DV2 app, available on both iOS and Android, allowing for effortless control of action camera settings.

COMPLETE ACCESSORIES KIT INCLUDED: Get everything you need to start filming right away with a complete accessories kit that includes a handlebar mount, back clip, buckle mount, universal screw adaptor, 2x 1340mAh batteries, mounting options, 2x 3M adhesive tabs, a Type-C charging cable, and more!

VERSATILE SHOOTING MODES FOR ALL YOUR ADVENTURES: Choose from a variety of shooting modes, including Video Mode, Photo Mode, Burst Photo Mode, Time Lapse Video Mode, Time Lapse Photo Mode, and Pre-record Mode, to suit all your creative needs. Perfect for capturing your thrilling moments while helmet riding, traveling, or engaging in sports and adventure activities, the DIGITEK DAC 201 is your go-to camera for every exciting experience!
